## Purpose
The deployment log viewer and history.

## Responsibilities
- `DeploymentLog({id})` polls `remoteServersApi.deployment` while the deployment runs.
- `DeploymentHistory({deployments})` lists past deployments.

## Key elements
`DeploymentLog`, `DeploymentHistory`.

React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.
